name: ConfigureCortexCodeCLI
description: Install the Cortex Code CLI (cortex) and auto-configure a connection for CI/CD. Run after the Configure Snowflake CLI task in the same job.
helpMarkDown: Installs the Cortex Code CLI and, when the Configure Snowflake CLI task has set up workload identity (OIDC), writes a named connection to connections.toml so `cortex -c <name>` works. Linux agents only.
author: Snowflake Labs

inputs.name: cliChannel
inputs.label: Install channel
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cortex Code CLI release channel to install: stable or beta.

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: Cortex Code CLI version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version to install. 'latest' installs the newest release in the selected channel. A specific version (e.g. 1.5.2) is applied via `cortex update <version>` after install; this relies on the CLI's update semantics, which typically only move forward within a channel.

inputs.name: connectionName
inputs.label: Connection name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Connection name to write to connections.toml when an OIDC token is available from the Configure Snowflake CLI task. An existing connection with this name is never overwritten.
